payout_quote: Bonus: $75 cash for both you and your friend. You will receive a $75 referral bonus in your Payment Account within 14 business days of your friend successfully opening and funding an M1 account.
steps: Have a funded M1 brokerage account and get your unique Referral Link (Invest screen > Refer & Earn; choose a Payment Account)
Send your link to a friend who has never been an M1 customer
Friend signs up via your link and is approved for an M1 brokerage or retirement account

Friend deposits at least the Account Opening Minimum ($10,000 for individual/joint/custodial/trust/retirement accounts) within 30 calendar days of sign-up and maintains it for another 30 calendar days
$75 referral bonus is credited to your designated Payment Account within 14 business days
catches: Friend must deposit at least $10,000 (the Account Opening Minimum for all account types) and maintain it 30 days
Cap: maximum 10 referral bonuses per calendar year ($750/year)
Bonus must remain in the M1 account for a 90-day holding period after receipt — cannot be withdrawn or transferred externally during that period; withdrawing relinquishes the bonus
Bonus paid only into an open individual/joint Payment Account (non-retirement); referrer and friend each need one
Bonuses reportable to the IRS as miscellaneous income on Form 1099-MISC (or 1042-S)
Referral links for friends/family only — no public advertising, spam, or affiliate links (affiliate-link signups ineligible)
biggest_catch: Your friend must deposit $10,000 and keep it there 30 days — and the $75 bonus cannot be withdrawn for 90 days after you receive it.
eligibility: Funded M1 brokerage account holders; referred friend must be new to M1, US citizen/eligible US resident, 18+
timing: $75 credited within 14 business days of qualification; 90-day holding period before external withdrawal
